name: The Eastern Pylon
summary: A curious visitor in Un'Goro Crater asks you to locate the rumored Eastern Crystal Pylon. The reports describe a large structure lined with crystals.

sections.title: Rumors in the Crater
sections.body: A visitor staying in Un'Goro Crater has heard rumors of mysterious pylons in its wilderness. Though they have never seen one, the visitor believes the rumors may connect to the crystals found here. You are asked to find the one said to lie in the crater's eastern area.

faq.answer: It is a rumored structure in the eastern area of Un'Goro Crater, described as large and lined with crystals.

faq.q: Who asks me to find it?
faq.answer: J.D. Collie at Marshal's Refuge in Un'Goro Crater asks you to locate the Eastern Crystal Pylon.

faq.q: Why is the visitor curious about the pylon?
faq.answer: The visitor wonders whether the rumored pylons have something to do with the crystals found in the crater.

faq.q: Where is the pylon rumored to be?
faq.answer: The rumor places the Eastern Crystal Pylon in the eastern area of Un'Goro Crater.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Eastern Pylon
